nodes.text: @RealAlexJones Look I get it. It’s kind of a tricky word. I’m only saying this for radio listeners who can’t see there’s no n. It seems to redirect to hMPV anyway, but it’s “metapneumovirus” not “metapneumoniavirus”. Or just say hMPV so people remember it better.
